label: Stelmack 2006
setting: five sites: VA inpatient Blind Rehabilitation Center (Hines), VA outpatient low vision/eye clinic, and three outpatient low vision rehabilitation programs (VICTORS, Deicke Center, MEEI); veterans and private sector
diagnosis_mix: macular degeneration 69% inpatient BRC / 50% control / 67% outpatient; diabetic retinopathy 11% / 27% / 14%; glaucoma 8% / 8% / 7%; neurologic disorders 5% / 5% / 7%
recruitment: consecutive patients recruited at five sites May 2000-May 2002; 8 patients with serious health conditions and 11 with severe cognitive loss excluded by clinicians; control group = Hines VA waiting-list patients with test-retest only
notes: Responsiveness study not an accuracy study: no sens/spec and no reference standard; n=285 = 139 inpatient BRC + 116 outpatient + 30 control (p3; p3 text also says 136 inpatient); 3-month post-rehab telephone interview; n_enrolled not reported; age means by group 71 (SD 11.3; 42-87) inpatient BRC / 73 (SD 9.4; 49-88) control / 74 (SD 12.4; 27-90) outpatient; 93% male in inpatient BRC and control and 62% male in outpatient so pct_female NR overall; administration time 25-35 min (p5); habitual VA by best eye in Table 1 p3; same VA LV VFQ-48 items as the Stelmack 2004 validation sample (refs 9-12) possibly overlapping but not stated
